Professional Summary
Results-driven Senior Flutter Developer with 8+ years of hybrid mobile engineering experience — 6+ years specialized in Flutter & Dart — with 50+ production apps delivered across a career spanning Android, iOS, and Web, across Healthcare, Utility & Meter Reading, E-Commerce, Astrology, and OCR/AI domains.

Currently at iBAP Technologies Inc (USA), independently building the company's own Healthcare and Utility Customer Portal products for clients in India & USA, plus an internal field Meter Reading app in live production use by Saudi Arabia utility client Marafiq — working hands-on with REST & GraphQL APIs, offline-first architecture, biometric auth, and interactive data visualizations (FL Chart), while also leading Flutter onboarding for the team. Writes Widget & Unit tests for reliable releases and uses AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up code quality and debugging. Known for full-cycle product ownership — architecture through production release — using Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines for fast, dependable delivery.

Delivered across domains: Healthcare · Astrology · E-Commerce · Utility & Meter Reading · OCR & AI Tools · Food & Water Delivery · Attendance · Billing · AR/VR · Real-time Audio/Video.

Core strengths: Provider · Clean Architecture · REST APIs (Dio) · Firebase · Google ML Kit · SQLite (Offline-first) · Biometric Auth · Google Maps · ArcGIS · Speech-to-Text · Payment Gateways · AI/ML Integration. What sets me apart — complete ownership of every development phase with zero team dependency & full technical accountability.

8 Years of Professional Journey

iBAP Technologies Inc
Flutter Developer · USA 🇺🇸 · Remote
🟢 Current · 3 Years
📅 June 2023 – Present · 3 Years
  • Independently design and build iBAP's own Healthcare app (iCare) and Utility Customer Portal (iCX) for clients in India & USA — both currently in active development — plus an internal field Meter Reading app (iMR) in live production use by Marafiq's (Saudi Arabia) field teams.
  • Own each product end-to-end — UI/UX, architecture, and full API integration — using Provider state management with Clean Architecture and reusable widget libraries for long-term maintainability.
  • Integrate REST & GraphQL APIs via Dio with OAuth 2.0 / JWT token refresh; secure sensitive data with Flutter Secure Storage; build admin-managed content workflows and in-app support/chat systems.
  • Build offline-first sync architecture with SQLite — local capture when disconnected, automatic background sync on reconnect for zero data loss in low-connectivity field conditions.
  • Integrate international payment gateways (Card, Bank Transfer, Auto Pay, Wallet) and Syncfusion-based Excel export for operational field reporting.
  • Lead Flutter onboarding for the team — trained 2 developers on Clean Architecture, state management, and delivery workflows, cutting their ramp-up time to production-ready contribution.
  • Independently manage the full iOS release pipeline — certificates, provisioning profiles, and TestFlight builds shared with clients for UAT — plus end-to-end Android & iOS publishing via Google Play Console and App Store Connect.
